limitations: Only creators with a computed median_play; small creators (SMALL_SAMPLE) are shown but not comparable to CONSISTENT ones. The analysis-ready corpus is not a random sample of the niche: deep.py only ever processed reels that score.py had already ranked near the top of their creator's output, so its median robust_z is above zero by construction. Any contrast computed inside it compares strong videos with other strong videos, not strong with average (docs/M2RADAR_ANALYSIS_METHOD.md §1.4).
method: creator_stats latest snapshot, sorted by median_play desc, top 30 creators.
title: Creator median views, top 30
